gaussian_source.coefficient_semantics: exact binary source scalars; exact product of libcint radial contraction and cart2sph coefficients

generated_bounds.bound_source: original coefficients and emitted local geometry, not target quadrature or sampled maxima
generated_bounds.method: absolute differentiated polynomial coefficients, exact coordinate radius, per-axis exp(-m)<=2^-m

geometry.classification: mixed; no continuous basin label or complete flow enclosure is assumed

source.primitive_screening: all original Gaussian coefficients define the continuous source; screened native evaluations retain their numerical residual
